title: Sixtyfour AI is now backed by Y Combinator
summary: Sixtyfour AI is joining Y Combinator’s first-ever spring batch as we go all in on building the best AI research platform in the world.
body_markdown:
Y Combinator is a highly selective startup accelerator that has funded companies including Airbnb, Dropbox, Stripe, and Coinbase.


YC represents a major milestone for the founders after years of applying, building, learning, and staying close without getting in.


Sixtyfour started from frustration with manual customer discovery and the belief that deep research on businesses and people could be automated.


A founder paid Sixtyfour to find individual psychiatrists in specific geographies, proving that traditional data tools did not cover niche local markets well.


Sixtyfour is building an AI research platform that can surface actionable intelligence on nearly any person or business, especially obscure or hard-to-find companies.
